summary: Renders one corner's suspension/temperature gauge into the draw surface a2. The per-corner state is read from the input-state object dword_7C54E0 at a 296-byte-per-corner stride (non-zero dword at +2100 and non-zero byte at +2164 gate the active branch). When the corner is inactive the gauge blinks red, gated on the parity CRTFtol(dbl_8AFEA0) % 2. When active and the per-car dword at +18580 of the car selected by dword_7C54DC equals that of the car selected by dword_7C54E4, it draws three color-encoded segments built from the corner temperature table at 8157696 (a double converted from Kelvin to Celsius by -273.16, then passed to FloatToColorEncoding); otherwise it draws the whole bar in the fixed green color.

local_names.a1: corner index; also offsets the corner temperature entry by 1124*a1
local_names.a3: bar x position passed through to the draw call
local_names.a4: bar width passed through to the draw call
local_names.a5: bar length passed through to the draw call
local_names.v12: corner temperature read as a double and converted from Kelvin to Celsius
local_names.v6: segment index 0..2 controlling the three-segment draw

operations.description: Enter the active-corner branch only when the corner entry at dword_7C54E0 + 296*a1 has a non-zero dword at +2100 and a non-zero byte at +2164; otherwise fall through to the blink path.

Compare the per-car dword at +18580 of the car selected by dword_7C54DC (via dword_7C54F0) with the +18580 dword of the car selected by dword_7C54E4; equality selects the three-segment draw, inequality the plain green bar.

Loop over three segments: for segment v6 in {0,1,2}, compute segment start v8 = a3 + v6*(a5/3) and end v9 (a3 + a5 for the first two segments, a3 + 2*(a5/3) + a5/3 for the last), read the corner temperature double at 1124*a1 + 8*v6 + 8157696, subtract 273.16 to convert Kelvin to Celsius, encode it with FloatToColorEncoding, and draw the segment via RenderDrawOperationWithClipping(a2, v8, a4, v9 - v8, color).
In the unequal-car branch, draw the full gauge bar with RenderDrawOperationWithClipping(a2, a3, a4, a5, -16711936), the fixed green color, and return its result.

In the inactive-corner branch, compute the blink gate result = CRTFtol(dbl_8AFEA0) % 2; when the remainder is zero draw the whole bar with RenderDrawOperationWithClipping(a2, a3, a4, a5, -65536), the fixed red color, and return it.
Return the last draw result from the active path (the final segment draw) or the blink remainder when the blink gate rejected the red draw.
